data.content_ref: inline:The target commits a category error: it equates 'has survived attempts to falsify it' with 'most informative,' but Popperian informativeness is logical/testability content, not survival history. The defense therefore cannot justify the wager as maximizing learning; an ad hoc or low-content survivor could be the last one not-yet-shown-wrong while being less informative than an eliminated high-content rival. The mechanism also overstates 'the only one not yet shown to be wrong'—many untested or unfalsified alternatives normally exist—so the claimed preference is not entailed by error elimination alone.
